user_query: I'm developing a language learning game and I need an API that can generate vocabulary quizzes for different languages.

TaskList.description: Research and identify suitable APIs that can generate vocabulary quizzes in multiple languages.
Evaluate the identified APIs for additional features such as scoring and progress tracking.
Select the most suitable API based on functionality, cost, and ease of integration into the game.
Integrate the selected API into the language learning game for generating quizzes.
Test the quiz generation functionality and the scoring and progress tracking features to ensure they meet requirements.
